strategy.thesis: Full-stack, sector-agnostic venture and growth firm spun out of Sequoia Capital in 2023, backing founders from seed through growth across India and Southeast Asia.

summary.en: Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA) is the leading India- and Southeast Asia-focused multi-stage venture and growth firm, managing approximately US$9 billion across 13 funds and 400+ portfolio companies. It became independent from Sequoia in 2023.

strategy.thesis: Stage- and sector-agnostic early-stage-led firm (formerly SAIF Partners), focused on consumer tech, consumer brands, fintech, enterprise AI, frontier tech and healthcare in India.

summary.en: Elevation Capital (formerly SAIF Partners), founded 2002 by Ravi Adusumalli and headquartered in Gurugram, is a stage- and sector-agnostic India VC. It raised a $670M Fund VIII in 2022, has invested ~$2B across 150+ companies, and backs 13+ unicorns including Paytm, Swiggy and Meesho.

strategy.thesis: India-US cross-border early-stage firm: backs transformative AI and software in the US and digital-native businesses (SaaS, supply chain, consumer internet, fintech, agritech) in India.

summary.en: Nexus Venture Partners, founded 2006, is a pioneering India-US cross-border early-stage VC managing ~$2.6B in AUM with offices in Mumbai, Bengaluru and Menlo Park. Its largest fund ($700M) closed in 2023; it has invested in 249 companies including Delhivery, Postman and Druva.

strategy.thesis: India-focused multi-stage venture fund (formerly Matrix Partners India) investing from seed through Series B across SaaS, fintech, consumer, healthtech and enterprise; rebranded Z47 in 2024 to reflect India's 2047 development vision.

summary.en: Z47 (formerly Matrix Partners India), entered India in 2006 and rebranded in July 2024, is a Bengaluru-based India-focused multi-stage VC. It manages around $1.5B, closed a ~$525M Fund IV in 2023, and has backed 100+ startups including Razorpay, Ola and Dailyhunt.

strategy.thesis: Patient-capital, early-to-mid-stage firm founded by ex-Sequoia India partners, backing enduring Indian businesses in consumer, technology, financial services and healthcare.

summary.en: A91 Partners, founded 2018 by former Sequoia Capital India partners and headquartered in Mumbai, is a patient-capital early-to-mid-stage firm. It has raised three funds ($351M, $550M, $665M) for ~$1.5B AUM, backing Digit, SUGAR Cosmetics, Atomberg and Exotel.

strategy.thesis: India's leading homegrown early-stage/seed fund backing technology-led founders solving large Indian problems or taking Indian innovation global.

strategy.thesis: India-headquartered technology VC (formerly IDG Ventures India) investing across digital consumer, enterprise software, fintech and deeptech, with a dedicated frontier/deeptech program.

summary.en: Chiratae Ventures (formerly IDG Ventures India), founded 2006 by Sudhir Sethi and T.C.M. Sundaram and headquartered in Bengaluru, is a multi-stage India technology VC managing $1.3B across seven funds. It has made 135+ investments and 60 exits, backing 8 unicorns including Lenskart, Myntra and PolicyBazaar.
